cases.title: A suitable evidence job uses an economical worker
cases.given: The task contains a clearly bounded evidence job that does not need final judgment or hard execution.
cases.when: The parent routes that evidence job with enough information to choose its worker.
cases.then: The job is assigned to an economical non-lead, non-hard worker, and its bounded findings return to the parent.
cases.why: Substantive evidence work is handled without spending a lead or hard-execution worker on collection.
cases.source: supplied operator intent: Delegate substantive evidence collection/execution early; conversation and trivial work stay inline.

setup.text: A clearly bounded evidence job does not need final judgment or hard execution.

steps.text: Ask for the substantive task.
Assign the bounded evidence job to an economical worker.
Return bounded findings without taking a lead decision.
Use the findings to continue the task.

asserts.text: The bounded evidence job is assigned to an economical worker.
The parent receives the worker's bounded findings.
A lead or hard-execution worker is not assigned to collect the evidence.

cases.title: A misframed judgment scout is paused and reframed
cases.given: A scout receives an assignment that asks it to make a final judgment or lead hard execution.
cases.when: The parent reviews the assignment before the scout proceeds.
cases.then: The scout is paused with a reframe reason, and the work can be separated into bounded evidence for the scout and judgment or hard execution for the parent or another worker.
cases.why: Scouts remain economical evidence collectors instead of silently becoming expensive judgment workers.
cases.source: supplied operator intent: Scouts collect bounded evidence and never become lead/hard judgment workers. A misframed scout should be reframed.

setup.text: The assignment asks for a final judgment or hard execution.

steps.text: Review the assignment before the scout proceeds.
Pause the scout and provide the reason for the reframe.
Separate the bounded evidence work from judgment or hard execution.
Return evidence only after the reframe.
Keep final judgment or hard execution with the parent or another worker.

asserts.text: The scout is paused with a clear reframe reason.
The work can be separated into bounded evidence and judgment or hard execution.
The scout does not silently execute the judgment or hard-execution assignment.

cases.title: Uncertain routing returns to the parent
cases.given: A routing attempt cannot confidently determine the general task type or difficulty from the available context.
cases.when: Routing returns the uncertain decision to the parent.
cases.then: The parent sharpens the task from existing context for one clarified retry, asking the operator only if a material decision is needed.
cases.why: Uncertain routing gets a focused parent decision instead of silently retaining an expensive lead-derived model.
cases.source: supplied operator intent: Uncertain general task type or difficulty should return to parent for ONE clarified retry, never silently retain an expensive lead-derived model.

setup.text: Task type or difficulty remains uncertain from the available context.

steps.text: Return the uncertain decision to the parent.
Sharpen the task from existing context for one clarified retry.

asserts.text: The parent sharpens the task from existing context.
No worker launches while task type or difficulty remains uncertain.
The parent does not ask the operator to classify routine routing uncertainty.
An expensive lead-derived model is not silently retained.

cases.title: A clarified retry can proceed
cases.given: The parent has enough context to make a clarified retry, or the operator has made a material decision.
cases.when: The parent performs the one clarified retry.
cases.then: The parent launches an appropriate worker and the task proceeds without carrying over an expensive lead-derived choice.
cases.why: A focused parent retry recovers useful delegation without silently retaining a costly model.
cases.source: supplied operator intent: Uncertain general task type or difficulty should return to parent for ONE clarified retry, never silently retain an expensive lead-derived model.

setup.text: The parent has sharpened the task from context or received a material decision.

steps.text: Retry routing once using the clarified task.
Proceed with the clarified task.

asserts.text: One clarified retry reaches an appropriate worker.
The clarified task proceeds with the worker choice.
The earlier expensive lead-derived choice is not carried into the retry.

cases.title: Automatic chat-cycle selection is declined with guidance
cases.given: An automatic job would select a Medium or slow chat-cycle role while the operator's chat model and defaults are already set.
cases.when: The automatic selector reaches that role choice.
cases.then: The selection is declined with guidance, and the operator's existing chat settings remain unchanged.
cases.why: Automatic work should not silently substitute a different chat-cycle role or take control of the operator's conversation settings.
cases.source: supplied operator intent: Automatic jobs do not use Medium/slow chat-cycle roles; preserve operator chat choices and explicit named-model reviews.

setup.text: The operator has chosen chat model and default settings.

steps.text: Offer the Medium or slow chat-cycle role.
Decline the role and provide guidance instead of silently substituting it.
Leave the operator's chat model and defaults unchanged.

asserts.text: The automatic selection is declined with guidance.
The operator's existing chat model and defaults remain unchanged.
A different chat-cycle role is not silently substituted.

cases.title: A deliberate named review remains allowed
cases.given: The operator explicitly names a model for a review.
cases.when: The parent starts that review through deliberate named selection.
cases.then: The review runs with the operator's requested named model even though automatic jobs do not use Medium or slow chat-cycle roles.
cases.why: Deliberate named-model reviews remain under operator control while automatic role selection stays narrower.
cases.source: supplied operator intent: Automatic jobs do not use Medium/slow chat-cycle roles; preserve operator chat choices and explicit named-model reviews.

setup.text: The operator has explicitly named the model for a review.

steps.text: Request the review with the named model.
Start the review with the operator's requested named model.
Return the review result.

asserts.text: The review runs with the operator's requested named model.
The deliberate named-model review remains an allowed path.
Automatic chat-cycle role restrictions do not block the deliberate named review.

cases.title: Exhausted Codex follows ordinary selection
cases.given: Codex has exhausted its normal worker quota and another eligible worker is available.
cases.when: The parent performs ordinary worker selection.
cases.then: The parent does not launch Codex and selects the eligible alternative under normal quota rules.
cases.why: Codex exhaustion should affect ordinary selection consistently instead of receiving an exemption.
cases.source: supplied operator intent: Remove existing Codex quota exemption so its workers use existing quota logic.

setup.text: Codex has no remaining normal worker quota, and another worker is eligible.

steps.text: Apply the ordinary quota check before launch.
Select the eligible alternative under the same ordinary rules.
Proceed with the delegated work.

asserts.text: The eligible alternative is selected and proceeds with the work.
Codex is not launched after its normal quota is exhausted.
Codex does not receive a quota exemption.
